_meta.deterministic_note: no wall-clock in payload; re-run is byte-stable unless an input artifact changed.
_meta.convention: standing-wave TCMT (brief Sec.2): A ~= 2 Q_i/Q_w, A=1% => Q_w = 200 Q_i, T=99.0%.

geometry.a_provenance: cavity-line rescale: a = nu0 * lambda0 with nu0=0.283785 (isolated tuned L3 s0.20 rdef1.15, res18 deep lossless ring-down) and lambda0=c/145GHz; places the cavity line at 145.000 GHz (decisions 2026-07-24 AT-2 CLOSED). Note the AT-0 bulk-midgap-centred a was 638.01 um; the device uses the cavity-line a.

cavity_detail.defect_ring: 8 transverse (j=N+/-1) + 2 end (row N, +/-2) holes scaled by rdef
cavity_detail.outer_rows_note: ladder/S21 cells carry >=8 outer mirror rows on the far side or Q_i is cell-limited (decisions 2026-07-24 ladder lesson).
cavity_detail.parity_note: Hz pseudovector: MEEP phase (+1,-1,+1) realises parity (-1,+1,+1) (decisions 2026-07-23).

geometry.N_rows_note: side-coupled W1 separation in rows; the coupling knob.
geometry.lattice: triangular air holes in HR-Si slab; TE-like polarization carries the gap
geometry.chip_scale: >=15x15 periods (~9x9 mm) to suppress in-plane leakage

modes.f0_note: by construction (a chosen so the cavity line = 145 GHz).
modes.Q_rad_intrinsic_note: vertical-radiation ceiling band. res12-noavg lateral series Q=9204(16a)->27577(20a)->29961(24a) saturates -> Q_vert~3.0e4; applying the measured res12-noavg->res18+subpixel correction (~-11%) gives intrinsic Q_rad~2.7-3.0e4. Brief target >=5e4 renegotiated to this measured ceiling (decisions 2026-07-24 AT-2 CLOSED); further gain needs multi-hole/heterostructure design (out of scope).
modes.Q_rad_smallcell_16a_note: isolated L3 in a 16a cell (res18 deep lossless, Q=8576.4, reliable); a lateral-leakage artifact of the small cell, NOT the physical ceiling.
modes.Q_mat_note: loss closure Q_mat = 1/(1/Q_tot - 1/Q_rad) from the 16a res18 pair (lossy Q_tot=7363.7, lossless Q_rad=8576.4) => ~5.21e4, vs theory 1/tan_delta=5.0e4 (closes to ~4%).
modes.Q_i_insitu_24a_note: in-situ cavity Q_i, N=3 capped ladder run (res18, 24a cell, stationary over 7000p). Sits between the 16a isolated value (8576) and the vertical ceiling (2.7-3.0e4), consistent with the lateral-leakage picture.
modes.V_mode_um3_note: = V_mode_a3 * a^3 at the device a=586.74 um (scale-invariant a^3 value from l3_3d_final res18).
modes.cavity_line_gap_note: TE gap edges at the device a=586.74 um; cavity line 145 GHz sits +7.5 GHz above the lower edge and -32.9 GHz below the upper edge (decisions 2026-07-24).

N3.units: MEEP-normalized E per sqrt(W of waveguide input), steady-state at the cavity centre (junction site)
N3.cmt_check_note: steady-state per sqrt(W); U_CMT=A*P_in*Q_i/omega0 check in analyze once Q_i (TCMT/harminv) is fixed. E2_boxint is the |E|^2 volume integral over the 2x2x0.5 a cavity box (MEEP units); multiply by eps and 1/2 for stored energy.

E_per_sqrtW.note: res18 field-transfer run exists only for N=3 (the ladder anchor). N2/N4 would each need a dedicated S21 field run (separate from the pending N2/N4 ring-down Q runs); N5 is extrapolated with the ladder.

anchor_res18_N3.note: 300-pt S21(f) + steady-state |E| field transfer; the res18 subpixel anchor curve.

coarse_res12_ladder.note: res12-noavg coarse ladder S21 curves; dispersion knobs invisible at res12-noavg staircasing (decisions 2026-07-24) -- use for trend only, not cavity-line numbers.

tcmt_check.Qw_N3_s21fit_note: two independent TCMT fits (band-power & flux) of the res18 S21 dip.
tcmt_check.consistency_note: brief AT-3 requires TCMT dip predicted from fitted Q's within 10%: PASS on {nu0, Q_w} (~8%). Only the dip DEPTH deviates.
tcmt_check.dip_depth_note: Fano / band-tail dilution: measured on-resonance dip ~5.8% (fit dip_depth=0.0593) vs the naive lossless two-port prediction ~81%. The cavity line sits in the W1 band tail, so the clean single-mode notch does not form (decisions 2026-07-24/25).
tcmt_check.offres_99p5_note: off-resonance transmission does NOT reach the brief's >=99.5% across +/-5 GHz: measured min T beyond 5 GHz = 0.9856. This is a band-tail artifact (cavity line inside the guided-band tail), not a loss.
tcmt_check.fit_Q_i_caveat: the S21-fit Q_i (~4.3e2) is NOT physical -- band-tail dilution corrupts the depth-derived Q_i; the ring-down Q_i (14611) is authoritative.

N2.note: near-critical: Q_loaded within 20% of Q_i (poor guided-band overlap); excluded from the exponential fit. Matches the N=2 anomaly of the 2D ladder (decisions 2026-07-23).

Q_i_anchor.note: in-situ Q_i (N=3 cap, res18, 24a cell) taken as the N-independent intrinsic anchor within the fixed 24a ladder cell; a per-N cap run would refine each Q_w.

exponential_fit.N_star_note: rows of separation needed for A=1%; outside [2,5] => extrapolated, informs M4's Q_w pick once Q_J is known.

N5.note: N=5 not simulated at res18; extrapolated via the exponential coupling law (justified, decisions 2026-07-25). Value fills in once the fit has >=2 non-anomalous ladder points.

ladder.method_note: Q via harminv ring-down (brief Sec.5 primary method): Q_loaded from the open-waveguide run, Q_i from the capped (waveguide row filled) run; convention-independent. The clean single-mode S21 dip is diluted by band-tail/Fano coupling (see tcmt_check).

tolerances.box: |dr/a|<=2%, |dt/a|<=5%, |da|<=2% (linear superposition, over-conservative: both edges pushed toward 145 GHz at once)
tolerances.a_analytic_note: nu=a/lambda depends only on r/a,t/a,eps (Maxwell scale invariance); f=nu*c/a scales as 1/a, so +2% in a => -1.961% in every frequency, -2% in a => +2.041%. No simulation needed for a.
tolerances.basis_note: computed on the BULK gap at the AT-0 midgap-centred a=638.01 um (bulk-gap level, brief item 3). Baseline bulk gap [126.4, 163.6] GHz. At the device cavity-line a=586.74 um the gap is [137.5, 177.9] GHz with cavity margins +7.5 / +32.9 GHz (see modes.cavity_line_gap_GHz).

provenance.stability_map: subpixel eps-averaging passivity violation at res 12-15 (NaN blow-up); only res 8 and res 18 verified stable. L3 scans: res12-noavg; all cavity-line/ladder physics: res18+subpixel (decisions 2026-07-23/24).
provenance.pwe_bias_note: the locked PWE gap table (N=5, 121 plane waves) carries 2-6% plane-wave truncation bias (largest on the upper edge); converged MPB is the truth. PWE edges drift monotonically toward MPB with N (decisions 2026-07-23 AT-1).

pending_runs.auto_fill: re-run scripts/export_photonics.py after these report status=done; ladder Q_loaded/Q_w and the exponential fit fill in idempotently.

renegotiations_vs_brief: AT-2 Q_rad target 5e4 -> measured vertical ceiling 2.7-3.0e4 (decisions 2026-07-24).
AT-0 'gap centred at 145 GHz' -> 'cavity line at 145 GHz, in-gap with quoted margins' (decisions 2026-07-23).
AT-3 clean single-mode dip / off-res >=99.5% not met: cavity line in W1 band tail; Q consistency still PASSES via ring-down (decisions 2026-07-24/25).
